responseB: Riverside Public Library is permanently extending its opening hours to 8 p.m. every day because visitors requested it.

responseA: A voluntary survey of 120 users found that 72 considered the documentation easy to follow, 30 were neutral, and 18 found it difficult. Easier-to-follow documentation was associated with higher onboarding ratings, but the survey cannot establish causation or represent all users.
